verdict.rationale: skills.sh's CLI explicitly documents non-interactive, CI/CD-friendly installation flags (--skill, -a, -y, -g) and headless usage via npx skills add/use with flags that avoid interactive prompts, suitable for automation pipelines. missing for 10: no independent CI pipeline case study or official GitHub Actions integration example, and no REST/API-only automation path (a community request notes absence of a REST API).
